notes.title: The StoryTale minor update and BigChick Demo playing with Clint Gamble
notes.notes:
Hi, there
I am going to release minor update for The StoryTale.

2)Also I am preparing to release XBox version on 19th of February.

3)And currently I am developing my next game
BigChick - a fun old good lemmings-type game.

You could play demo during Steam Game Festival or watch broadcasting now.
https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561198090002566

notes.title: April update
notes.notes:
-Gamepad auto-search was improved
-Large fonts for dialogues in Video submenu option can be switched (accessibility improving)
-Smooth camera when landing
-Dialogues bubble some bugs were fixed
-Goblins with spears always attack screaming (even if attack begins out of the view)
-CN/JP some hieroglyphs in the menu options were fixed
-Gif tips and bubble texts GUI alignment was improved

notes.title: March update
notes.notes:
GUI for 4k was fixed
 Full-screen display low resolution was fixed
 Read-write file operation number significantly were reduced
 Ukrainian voicing updated
 Improvement of the character’s jump so that he does not cling to the corners with his head
 Small fix on invisible blocks
 If you knock on vertical spikes, then at first they drive in gradually up to 50%, and then after a while immediately 100% (the problem of barely visible spikes that can still be touched is solved)
 The goblin enemies that are needed to access the hearts can no longer be replaced by goblin friends by random generation
 Some level design was updated

notes.title: January update
notes.notes:
Window mode
Some optimization 
Bug with no achivements fixed
Some minor fixes

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
If you can't find the key in 10 minutes, you will get gray key compass in the HUD.
Default language now is English (previously from bunch of Steam and OS setups it happened  to be Russian. I am really sorry, comrades. Good bye, Mother Russia)
And some minor translation and level design were updated

notes.title: New update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581619/426a0d2a051392d7388a06886436352dc7aaef27.jpg The powerful update, like the last fan art :)
+ random bounce from the wall bug was fixed
+ reduce the strength of water flows (easy difficulty)
+ Increase the operating time of the levers (easy difficulty)
+ slimes do not spawn on the chests
+ ice tracks on the generated snow mountains levels
+ invisible slimes after founain restart should be invisible again
+ more fountains at step-by-step levels
+ vertical (on the wall) spikes are "pressed" 1 pixel inside when the princess hits them
+ now broblins (goblins-friends)  give full protection from projectiles, magic and small mobs, no matter how many of their quests are completed

notes.title: Current update
notes.notes:
1)Miniquests: classic quest UI improvement. 
If a broblin (bro-goblin) wants you to bring some item to him you'll see a question mark above him. If you find and get this item then you'll see an  exclamation mark above him.
So, shortly, usually you need to run to somebody with exclamation mark :)
We hope it could make the side-quests (the only we have) more clear to players 

2)Some minor level design improvement

3)German language is coming. We get the text translated back and it's in work now for next build update.
